skycosmetics.name: SkyCosmetics
modmenu.summaryTranslation.skycosmetics: Skins, dyes, names and glint for your SkyBlock items and pets.
skycosmetics.menu.broken: This section couldn't load. See the log.
skycosmetics.menu.tooSmall: Make the window bigger or lower the GUI scale.
skycosmetics.menu.section.studio.tooltip: Changes how your items and pets look: skins, dyes, names and glint.
skycosmetics.option.openStudio.tooltip: Opens the studio for your held item, or any item in My Items.
skycosmetics.option.openStudio.noWorld: Join a world to use the studio
skycosmetics.option.openKey.tooltip: Opens the studio for the hovered item in any menu, or your held item.
skycosmetics.option.openKey.listening.to: Press a key or mouse button. Esc cancels, Backspace unbinds.
skycosmetics.option.inventoryButton.tool: Shows a brush on your player in the inventory that opens the studio.
skycosmetics.option.learnSkins.tooltip: Remembers skins the item repo doesn't have yet, like new shop previews.
skycosmetics.option.storedItems.tooltip: Lists items from menus you open, like your Wardrobe, Ender Chest and Backpacks. Off: only what you wear and carry.
skycosmetics.option.storedItems.search: wardrobe ender chest backpack vault auto fill fetch
skycosmetics.option.allProfiles.tooltip: Lists items from all your SkyBlock profiles in My Items, not only the current one.
skycosmetics.option.worldReskin.tooltip: Shows your chosen skins on your summoned pet and placed power orbs.
skycosmetics.option.typeLooksOnOthers.to: Shows your looks for a whole item type (e.g. every Necron's Helmet) on other players too. Only you see them.
skycosmetics.option.namesInOtherMods.too: Lets other mods show your custom names, even in chat replies like Odin's !holding. Off: they see the original.
skycosmetics.studio.settings.tooltip: Open key, My Items and more
skycosmetics.studio.settings.keyTip: Set a key to open the studio from any menu
